name: Mumbai
description: India's financial capital, blending colonial architecture, Bollywood glamour and a relentless street-food scene.

name: Goa
description: Beaches, Portuguese heritage churches, spice plantations and India's most famous nightlife.

name: Gokarna
description: A quiet temple town with crescent beaches, a laid-back alternative to Goa.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City, gateway to Rajasthan, packed with forts, palaces and bazaars.

name: Udaipur
description: The City of Lakes, known for Lake Pichola, palace hotels and Aravalli sunsets.

name: Jaisalmer
description: A golden sandstone fort city on the edge of the Thar Desert.

name: Delhi
description: The capital, layering Mughal monuments, colonial avenues and a vast food culture.

name: Agra
description: Home of the Taj Mahal and two more UNESCO World Heritage sites.

name: Varanasi
description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, on the ghats of the Ganges.

name: Rishikesh
description: Yoga capital of the world and India's white-water rafting hub, in the Himalayan foothills.

name: Manali
description: A Himalayan resort town for snow, trekking and the road to Ladakh.

name: Leh
description: High-altitude desert capital of Ladakh, surrounded by monasteries and mountain passes.

name: Shimla
description: Former British summer capital, reached by the UNESCO-listed toy train.

name: Amritsar
description: Home of the Golden Temple and the Wagah border ceremony.

name: Kochi
description: A spice-trade port with Chinese fishing nets, Dutch and Portuguese quarters.

name: Alleppey
description: The Kerala backwaters, best seen from an overnight houseboat.

name: Munnar
description: Rolling tea plantations and cloud forests in the Western Ghats.

name: Hampi
description: A UNESCO boulder-strewn landscape of Vijayanagara temple ruins.

name: Bengaluru
description: India's tech capital, with a strong craft-beer, cafe and live-music scene.

name: Chennai
description: Tamil cultural capital with Marina Beach, temples and Carnatic music.

name: Pondicherry
description: A former French colony with pastel streets, cafes and Auroville nearby.

name: Darjeeling
description: Tea estates and Kanchenjunga views, reached by the Himalayan Railway.

name: Kolkata
description: India's cultural capital, known for colonial architecture, coffee houses and Durga Puja.

name: Shillong
description: The Scotland of the East, with waterfalls, living root bridges nearby and a rock-music scene.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Coral reefs, scuba diving and some of Asia's cleanest beaches.

name: Ahmedabad
description: India's first UNESCO World Heritage City, known for pol houses and street food.

name: Udupi
description: Temple town and the birthplace of Udupi cuisine, near Malpe beach.

name: Coorg
description: Coffee country in the Western Ghats, with misty hills and homestays.

name: Bangkok
description: Temples, floating markets, street food and one of Asia's great transit hubs.

name: Bali
description: Rice terraces, surf breaks, volcano hikes and Hindu temple culture.

name: Singapore
description: A dense, green city-state known for hawker centres and modern architecture.

name: Kathmandu
description: Gateway to the Himalayas, with durbar squares and stupas.

name: Colombo
description: Sri Lanka's coastal capital, a mix of colonial and modern architecture.

name: Dubai
description: Desert megacity of record-breaking towers, souks and dune safaris.

name: Paris
description: Museums, boulevards and food that anchors most first trips to Europe.

name: Rome
description: Two thousand years of ruins, basilicas and Roman food, walkable end to end.

name: London
description: Free world-class museums, theatre and markets across distinct neighbourhoods.

name: Tokyo
description: A city of neighbourhoods, from Shinjuku neon to quiet Yanaka temples.

name: Istanbul
description: Straddling Europe and Asia, with Byzantine and Ottoman monuments side by side.

name: New York
description: Five boroughs of museums, parks, food and skyline.
